_source: Values verified against the recorded page itself: it carries a `Product Net Weight` label with `0.22 kg`, and a `155 mm` dimension. Title is `EKIP BUSBARS SUPPLY E1.3...E6.3`.

_notes.why: Positive baseline for the generic HTML path — an ABB page that already works. Its job is regression protection: the weight/dimensions extraction here must not break when the generic parser is reworked in P1.1/P1.3.
_notes.mustNotContain: The page's inline CSS contains `font-weight: 500 !important` and `font-weight: 400`. Those are the classic false positives for a weight extractor scanning raw page text, so they are pinned as forbidden.
